key_insight: Paper Circle uses an open-source multi-agent LLM framework to automate discovery, evaluation, and organization of scientific papers, drastically reducing manual effort for literature review and synthesis.
problem_solved: Researchers face information overload as scientific literature grows, making it time-consuming to find relevant work, assess quality, and synthesize insights across papers.
method: Orchestrates specialized agents (e.g., search, summarizer, evaluator, curator) that collaborate to find, read, score, and organize papers.
Integrates tool chains (web APIs, PDF parsers, citation/metadata graphs) so agents can fetch sources, extract content, and compute relevance/quality metrics.
Open-source, modular pipelines allow configurable workflows for discovery, summarization, critique, and knowledge organization.
impact: Enables faster, more systematic literature reviews and better-informed research decisions; lowers the barrier to staying current and reproducible in AI/ML work.
visual_elements: Pipeline flowchart showing agent roles (search → fetch → summarize → evaluate → organize)
Dashboard mockup with ranked paper list, short summaries, and quality/relevance scores
Architecture diagram illustrating agents, tool integrations (PDF parser, APIs, citation graph), and data flow
Example 'paper card' visual: title, 1-line summary, key contributions, and confidence/quality badges
paper_title: Paper Circle: An Open-source Multi-agent Research Discovery and Analysis Framework
paper_authors: Komal Kumar, Aman Chadha, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Hisham Cholakkal
